text:
Maria: FYI the Ruby quickstart curl example uses "Auth: Bearer" instead of "Authorization: Bearer" and the Ruby snippet omits the require line. New users hit 401s and confusion.

Devon: Yikes. Which file?

Maria: docs/quickstarts/ruby/README.md around the curl/code blocks. I'll send a small PR to fix the header and add `require 'redwood_inference'`.

Sam: We did rename the gem earlier; confirm the require matches the published gem so we don't flip it twice.

Priya: Can we add a tiny docs CI check to run curl snippets against docs-staging and fail on 401 or missing Authorization header? Also add a short CONTRIBUTING note to test copy/paste snippets.

Maria: Opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/1301 — fixes header, adds require, clarifies env var REDWOOD_API_KEY, and a CONTRIBUTING hint.

docs-bot: Created issue #3490 for ruby quickstart snippet mismatch (reported by Maria).

Maria: Merged and backported to the 1.0 branch. Leaving thread in case someone wants details on the CI lint job.

Devon: Great catch. Thanks Maria :thumbsup:
